_about: Questions for rag_corpus.json. relevant_ids are corpus entry ids; a retrieved chunk is relevant if it comes from that entry (chunk metadata entry_id). 'kind' lets the report be sliced. Empty relevant_ids = not in the corpus: the right behaviour is to decline, and the retrieval question is how often irrelevant context still gets through. Self-written, so use for comparing versions, not as an accuracy estimate.

cases.question: How long does a refund take for a Cash on Delivery order?
cases.expected_answer: By bank transfer (NEFT) in 7-10 business days after the returned item is received; the customer must share account number and IFSC.

cases.question: I paid online, in how many days will my refund reach my card?
cases.expected_answer: Prepaid refunds are processed in 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

cases.question: If I take the refund in wallet instead of my bank, how fast do I get it?
cases.expected_answer: Wallet credit arrives within 2 hours of the return pickup being completed.

cases.question: Mera parcel toota hua aaya, photo kab tak bhejni hai?
cases.expected_answer: Within 48 hours of delivery; then refund or replacement can be chosen.

cases.question: They delivered the wrong item. Do I pay for the return?
cases.expected_answer: No. The customer is not charged; pickup in 2-3 days and the right item ships in 4-6 days, or a full refund if it is out of stock.

cases.question: I used a bit of the face cream and it caused a rash. Can I get my money back?
cases.expected_answer: Opened or partially used cosmetics are not refundable; if defective only an exchange is offered, requested within 5 days of delivery.

cases.question: Will my shipping charge be refunded?
cases.expected_answer: Not normally; only if the item was defective, damaged or wrong, then it is refunded with the price.

cases.question: What is the return window for a laptop?
cases.expected_answer: Electronics have a 10-day return window, sealed box with all accessories; opened items only if dead on arrival or defective.

cases.question: Can I return sneakers after 10 days?
cases.expected_answer: No. Footwear returns are only within 7 days, unworn, in the original box.

cases.question: I bought a kurta 12 days ago and it does not fit, what can I do?
cases.expected_answer: Apparel can be returned within 15 days with tags and unworn; a free size exchange is also available within 15 days.

cases.question: Can I return a pack of socks?
cases.expected_answer: No. Innerwear, swimwear and socks are not returnable for hygiene reasons unless the wrong size or item was sent.

cases.question: I already exchanged the size once and need to swap again. Is it free?
cases.expected_answer: No. A second exchange for the same item costs Rs 79 for reverse pickup.

cases.question: Courier return pickup ke liye nahi aaya, ab kya hoga?
cases.expected_answer: Courier tries 3 times; if all fail the return request closes and the customer must request again.

cases.question: When will my order reach Jaipur?
cases.expected_answer: Jaipur is not a listed metro: standard delivery takes 7-10 business days.

cases.question: Is there any way to get my order in a day or two?
cases.expected_answer: Express delivery in 1-2 business days in 20 cities for Rs 99, order before 2 pm for same-day dispatch.

cases.question: My cart is Rs 450, will I be charged for delivery?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, Rs 49 shipping applies below Rs 499; it is free from Rs 499.

cases.question: I live in a hill station. Can I choose express delivery?
cases.expected_answer: No. Remote and hill pincodes take 2-3 extra days and express is not available.

cases.question: My parcel came 5 days after the promised date. Do I get anything for it?
cases.expected_answer: Orders more than 3 days late are eligible for a Rs 100 compensation coupon, issued by support on request.

cases.question: Order dispatch ho gaya, ab cancel kaise karun?
cases.expected_answer: After dispatch the order cannot be cancelled; only a return after delivery.

cases.question: I entered the wrong flat number. Can I fix the address?
cases.expected_answer: Only within 2 hours of placing the order and before dispatch, from My Orders > Edit address.

cases.question: hw do i trak my ordr
cases.expected_answer: Through the SMS link sent at dispatch or My Orders; status refreshes every 6-12 hours.

cases.question: The tracking page has shown the same status for two days.
cases.expected_answer: After 48 hours without movement support raises a trace with logistics, who reply within 24 hours.

cases.question: I need a GST invoice for my company.
cases.expected_answer: The GST invoice is emailed after delivery and downloadable from My Orders; the business GSTIN can only be added at checkout.

cases.question: I want to order 25 units of the same item for my office.
cases.expected_answer: More than 10 units of one item is a bulk order, placed through the sales team, not the app.

cases.question: Payment cut ho gaya lekin order fail dikha raha hai
cases.expected_answer: The bank reverses it automatically in 5-7 business days; do not pay again right away, check status after 30 minutes.

cases.question: My UPI payment is stuck on pending.
cases.expected_answer: Usually resolved within 30 minutes; if debited but no order, the amount returns in 3-5 business days.

cases.question: Can I pay cash on delivery for a Rs 7,000 order?
cases.expected_answer: No. COD is only up to Rs 5,000 (with a Rs 40 fee); above that online payment is required.

cases.question: Is EMI possible on a Rs 2,500 purchase?
cases.expected_answer: No. EMI starts at Rs 3,000 on credit cards, for 3, 6 or 9 months.

cases.question: My card keeps getting declined at checkout.
cases.expected_answer: Check online/international transactions are enabled and the OTP reached the registered number; three declines block cards for 1 hour.

cases.question: Why won't my discount code work?
cases.expected_answer: Cart below the minimum, expired, or already applied; one coupon per order and not combinable with wallet cashback.

cases.question: How long is a gift card valid?
cases.expected_answer: 12 months from purchase; usable across orders until the balance is zero.

cases.question: i forgott my pasword
cases.expected_answer: Use Forgot Password on the login screen; OTP to the registered mobile is valid for 10 minutes.

cases.question: My account says locked even after I reset the password.
cases.expected_answer: Locked for 30 minutes after 5 wrong attempts; resetting the password does not unlock it earlier.

cases.question: I lost my old SIM, how do I change my registered number?
cases.expected_answer: An OTP on the OLD number is normally required; without it the customer must contact support with a government ID.

cases.question: What is the warranty on a refrigerator compressor?
cases.expected_answer: Appliances have 2 years; the compressor of refrigerators and ACs is covered for 5 years.

cases.question: Can I buy extended warranty a few months after delivery?
cases.expected_answer: Only within 30 days of delivery, 1 additional year at 8% of the product price.

cases.question: When do my loyalty points expire?
cases.expected_answer: 12 months after they are credited, with a reminder 30 days before.

cases.question: How much of my bill can I pay with points?
cases.expected_answer: At most 20% of the order value; 100 points = Rs 10; not on gift cards.

cases.question: What happens if I am not home for the third delivery attempt?
cases.expected_answer: After the third failed attempt the parcel returns to the warehouse and the refund starts within 3 business days.

cases.question: How do I report a fake product I received?
cases.expected_answer: Raise a counterfeit report from the order page; reviewed within 72 hours; confirmed cases get a full refund plus a Rs 200 coupon.

cases.question: How many addresses can I save in the app?
cases.expected_answer: Up to 10 saved addresses per account.

cases.question: aur kitne din lagenge?
cases.expected_answer: Cash on Delivery refunds take 7-10 business days after the item is received.

history.content: Mera COD order ka refund chahiye

cases.question: and what about the second time?
cases.expected_answer: A second exchange for the same item costs Rs 79 for reverse pickup.

history.content: Can I exchange my shirt size for free?
Yes, one free exchange per item.

cases.question: Do you ship to the USA?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; say so and offer a human agent.

cases.question: Is there a Shrivox store near Connaught Place?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; say so and offer a human agent.

cases.question: Will you match the price if Amazon sells it cheaper?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; no price-match policy exists in the knowledge base.

cases.question: Can I pay with Bitcoin?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; do not invent payment methods.

cases.question: Are you hiring delivery partners?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; outside support scope.

cases.question: Kya aap gift wrapping karte ho?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; say you will check and offer a human agent.

cases.question: I paid with a gift card, where does my refund go and how fast?
cases.expected_answer: Back to the same gift card balance within 24 hours of the return being approved; validity is not extended.

cases.question: Net banking se paise kat gaye par order confirm nahi hua, wapas kab aayenge?
cases.expected_answer: The bank reverses it in 2-4 business days; do not pay again until the status in My Orders is final.

cases.question: Can I return a sofa after I have assembled it?
cases.expected_answer: No. Furniture is returnable within 7 days only if unassembled and unused; assembly damage is not accepted.

cases.question: Will my order reach Pune in 5 days?
cases.expected_answer: Pune is not a listed metro, so standard delivery takes 7-10 business days; 5 days is not promised.

cases.question: Delivery to Mumbai kitne din mein hoga?
cases.expected_answer: Mumbai is a listed metro: standard delivery takes 4-7 business days.

cases.question: Is express delivery available in Lucknow?
cases.expected_answer: The KB says express covers 20 cities but does not list them: say you will check and offer a human agent rather than confirming or denying.

cases.question: Do you accept PayPal?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; say you will check and offer a human agent. Do not state that PayPal is or is not accepted.

cases.question: Do you provide installation for my new AC?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; say you will check and offer a human agent. Do not state that installation is or is not provided.

cases.question: Do you deliver on Sundays?
cases.expected_answer: Not covered; say you will check and offer a human agent. Do not state that Sunday delivery is or is not offered.

cases.question: Will my order reach Bangalore in 5 days?
cases.expected_answer: Bangalore (Bengaluru) is a listed metro: standard delivery takes 4-7 business days, so 5 days is possible but not guaranteed.

cases.question: How many days will standard delivery take?
cases.expected_answer: 4-7 business days to the listed metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad) and 7-10 business days to all other locations; ask which city.

cases.question: Gurgaon mein standard delivery kitne din mein hogi?
cases.expected_answer: Gurgaon is not a listed metro, so standard delivery takes 7-10 business days.
